title: Servo-based autoscaler: congestion-sink + throughput certifier
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce servo-based autoscaler with a configurable congestion credit sink and throughput certification job; exposes new telemetry for headroom and certified throughput percentiles.
description:
Summary: Implement a servo-style autoscaler that reacts to short-term congestion by absorbing excess burst credit into a configurable 'congestion sink' and validating achieved throughput against a light-weight certifier job. This PR wires the autoscaler into Dedicated fleet controllers, adds telemetry for certified throughput (p50/p95/p99) and headroom decay, and provides a route to safely experiment with the controller via feature flags. Motivation: current burst controls allow temporary overshoot but lack a graceful mechanism to drain transient credit while preserving SLOs. We need a controller that (1) dampens oscillation on recovery, (2) provides quantitative certification of throughput after scaling events, and (3) emits signals operators can use to tune policy.
Key changes (high-level):
- Introduce autoscaler/servo package: core loop, congestion sink abstraction, rate-of-change limiter.
- Add telemetry hooks: certified_throughput_{p50,p95,p99}, headroom_decay_seconds, congestion_sink_balance.
- Add a background certifier job that issues short validation load against newly provisioned pools and reports pass/fail and observed throughput.
- Feature-flagged rollout (config flag: autoscale.servo.enabled) with staged default off.
